evaluate_state.description: Evaluate a state against a map of typed questions and get back structured answers, one per question.

params.name: state
params.description: The content to evaluate: a plain string for text, or structured data (object/array) for chat logs, records, or app state.

params.name: model
params.description: The model that handles the request, e.g. "jev-latest" (alias) or a pinned version like "jev-1.13.0". See the models group.

params.name: questions
params.description: A map of typed Question objects, keyed by a caller-chosen id (answers come back under the same keys; the key itself is never sent to the model). Each Question is a discriminated union on its 'type' field, one of 'noul', 'choice', or 'score'. All three share 'type' (required) and 'instructions' (required, string | object | array | null - arbitrary JSON accepted for clarity or to pass supporting data verbatim). Noul (type: 'noul'): a yes/no question; optional 'criteria' object with optional 'true'/'false' string (or object/array) descriptions of what a yes/no answer means. Choice (type: 'choice'): picks one option from a set; required 'criteria': map<string, string | object | array | null>, one entry per option, each value an optional rubric description (null when the option needs no extra detail). Score (type: 'score'): rates the state on a rubric; required 'criteria': an ordered array of at least two level descriptions (each a string, or an object/array for structured rubric detail). Any of the three types can be mixed in the same questions map in a single call; every question is evaluated in parallel and independently against the same state.

list_models.description: List the model names and aliases an account can send in the evaluate-state `model` field, with a description and release date for each.
